title: Tag
description: Fiori tag: semantic designs with state icons, Set1/Set2 colour schemes 1–10, sizes S/L, interactive.

usage.summary: Draw attention to a category, condition or quantity with a compact enclosed marker.
useWhen: Help users spot a category, condition or quantity alongside surrounding content.
Use design for semantic meaning or a consistent indication color; enable interactive when pressing the marker opens related information.

avoidWhen.when: Show a number or attention dot attached to a button.
Describe a business object state with a label and status text rather than a category marker.
Represent an already selected value that users can remove from a field.
